notes: κατ' ἐκκλησίαν is read as one unit taking in every, the distributive sense being the preposition's; the head is placed on the prepositional word and the competing head on every is named in the unit's note.
The and before had prayed is a rule 88 juncture on the predicate it introduces, προσευξάμενοι being a participle converted to a coordinate finite clause.
SBLGNT.ACT.14.23.v028 is underdetermined with a base reading compatible with the ASV, so no rule 97 note is owed.
